result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all the listings you named. The full suite passes offline (608 tests, 0 failures).

What changed:
- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: new `description` component, added last, so existing field order is unchanged. It is null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: `createPromotion` has a new 6-argument overload that takes a description. The existing 5-argument version delegates to it with null, so current callers are unchanged. A null or blank description is stored as null, matching how blank categories are handled.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert and all six promotion queries (active on date, active in region, by category, best for category on date, unused in period, by code) now select and map `description`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInEveryListing` test. It creates SUMMER with the description and PLAIN without one, then checks the text in each listing and that PLAIN has none.

I did not commit anything.
